exposure: consumption of fresh fruits and fruit juices
cohort: 67 mothers of neonates diagnosed with transient hyperinsulinism and 113 mothers of controls
finding: The study found that gestational weight gain >15 kg, abnormal fetal heart rate, and C-section were risk factors for transient neonatal hyperinsulinism, while a diet rich in fresh cooked vegetables and reduced in fat was protective.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of transient neonatal hyperinsulinism.
